summary.text: Jess Rivera is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 4, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Eldon Sharpe Newton III (R).
A Marine Corps veteran, Rivera is a barber and owns a barbershop in Wilson.

paragraphs.text: Jess Rivera served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2004 to 2012, according to Ballotpedia, and earned a high school diploma from Murrieta Valley High School before attending Old Dominion University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Rivera said she deployed to Iraq on two combat tours, in 2005 and 2007.
Rivera said she owns The Garrison Barber & Parlor in downtown Wilson, North Carolina.

In the same survey, Rivera listed three campaign messages: rural health care, including investment in local hospitals and mental health services; well-funded rural schools and community colleges; and economic growth that, in her words, stays local and lifts the people doing the work.
She said the district covers Greene, Wayne and Wilson counties.
